content:
Apple is expected to hold an event on October 13 next week to launch several new products. According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, the new products will be unveiled at an "event". Here's what he said.

Gurman said Apple will launch three new products at its event on October 13.

It's been almost a month since Apple's last event, which unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Duo and other products.

But sources say Apple will soon hold an October launch event next Tuesday (October 13).

Gurman had previously reported that these three products would launch on October 13, but at the time he did not mention an event being held.

There has been much speculation about whether these new Home products warrant a standalone event. For example, John Gruber believes the rumored HomePad "could not possibly" be unveiled via a press release alone. He wrote: "If this product really is coming out, it has to be done with a keynote video and some media hands-on activities."

And according to his latest newsletter, Gurman clearly agrees. "Apple is planning to hold an event on October 13" sounds pretty straightforward.

If there really is an event, we expect to receive press invitations within the next day or two. Unless, of course, incoming CEO John Ternus plans to change the way products are launched, breaking with past convention.

What do you think — will Apple's Home line of products be launched at a proper October event, or announced via press release? Share your thoughts in the comments.
